title: Story Concept & Outline
use_cases: Use when establishing the high-level pitch and central theme of a project
Implement when creating a structural roadmap to guide AI content generation
Configure when balancing creative exploration with narrative focus
Use when defining a sequence of scenes to prevent circular revisions
content: Clarity of direction accelerates the entire writing process. Whether you're a meticulous plotter or someone who discovers the story through writing, you need at least the broad trajectory of your narrative and the thematic gravity holding it together. A story concept—consisting of a concise one- or two-sentence pitch plus a short paragraph of contextual detail—keeps your project anchored. Your outline, whether a simple three-act structure or an intricate sequence of scenes and turning points, serves as your navigational map. It guides the AI on where to explore freely and where to maintain focus, preventing endless revisions later.
